key_insight: RoboVIP generates multi-view, temporally consistent video augmentations using Visual Identity Prompting so that synthetic data preserves object identity and appearance across views and time, improving downstream robot manipulation learning with realistic, scalable visual variations.
problem_solved: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and temporally/multi-view consistent real-world manipulation data is costly and limited; prior image-edit augmentations (e.g., single-view diffusion edits) break object identity, viewpoint coherence, or temporal consistency, degrading policy training.
method: Introduce Visual Identity Prompting to anchor object appearance and identity across generated frames and camera views.
Generate multi-view, temporally-consistent video augmentations (built on image/video diffusion backbones) so augmented observations align with robot kinematics and trajectories.
Integrate augmented multi-view videos into policy training pipelines (imitation learning / RL), increasing dataset diversity while preserving realism needed for manipulation.
impact: Provides a practical way to scale realistic, identity-preserving visual augmentations for robot learning, improving generalization and data efficiency without expensive real-world collection. Practitioners can use RoboVIP to expand multi-view datasets and boost manipulation performance across varied environments.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: real robot video → Visual Identity Prompt → multi-view, temporally-consistent video generator → augmented dataset → policy training

paper_title: RoboVIP: Multi-View Video Generation with Visual Identity Prompting Augments Robot Manipulation
